messages:
ellie: Quick design check — pushed an iteration for the routing editor's compact flow stack and keyboard nav tweaks. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/ux/stack-compact-iter.png — can people skim for accessibility and copy nits? james: glanced — overall 👍. Two quick visual nits: divider contrast feels a bit low on 1200px pages, and the drag handle's touch target is ~18px which is small for mobile. maya: copy thing: validation message currently says "Overlap detected (rule disabled)" — that reads technical. Suggest: "Disabled — overlaps with another active rule. Click to view conflict." shorter but actionable. rob: @ellie for keyboard: does Tab land on the drag handle first? We should make arrow keys move between rows and Enter open edit modal. Also need clear focus ring for focused row. sarita: Agree with moving the handle to the left so it's the first tabbable element. Also we shouldn't rely solely on color to indicate priority — add a small icon (chevron/up arrow) and a visually hidden label for screen readers. sarita: quick CSS/ARIA snippet for the handle I prototyped:```button.drag-handle { aria-label: "Reorder rule"; tabindex: 0; }``` ellie: Good call. I'll flip the handle to left and wire the arrow-key behavior. For the preview simulator: I added a small "Simulate with sample traffic" toggle in the top toolbar. Should that be primary or secondary? It's visible but not as prominent as Save. james: secondary. Primary CTA should remain "Save & Apply". Move the simulate toggle into an overflow dropdown if space tight, or small icon button with tooltip. :thumbsup: maya: Another copy nudge: toast currently says "Invalid rule" which is vague. Maybe: "Cannot save — rule overlaps or missing required fields. Click to review." That gives next step. rob: Also, when sims run, emit a Console event tagged "policy.simulation.run" with metadata (policy_id, sim_set). Helps SRE/debugging. sarita: A11y nit: when preview updates we need to announce counts to screen readers. Use an aria-live region:```
Preview updated: 12 sample matches
``` ellie: I'll update the Figma and the front-end PR to include: left-side handle, bigger touch targets, stronger divider contrast, and aria-live announcement. Planning to ship as a patch Monday. ops-bot: UX patch 5421 queued for review in #deploy-ux — build 5421. ellie: thanks — will tag @design-review when PR is ready for a pass.
